The one-time setup takes about 5 minutes. You don\'t need a computer, but you do need Wi-Fi.

string-array.name: guide_setup_bodies
string-array.item: Tap \"Download Shizuku\" below, or search for \"Shizuku\" (by RikkaApps) in the Play Store and install it.
Go to Settings → About phone and tap \"Build number\" 7 times. Enter your PIN if asked. You\'ll see a message that you are now a developer.
Wireless debugging only works while the phone is connected to a Wi-Fi network. Your own hotspot doesn\'t count.
Open Shizuku. Under \"Start via Wireless debugging\", tap \"Pairing\". Allow notifications when Shizuku asks, because you enter the code through a notification.
Go to Settings → System → Developer options → Wireless debugging. Turn it on and tap \"Pair device with pairing code\". A 6-digit code appears. Stay on this screen.
Pull down the notification shade. In the Shizuku notification, tap \"Enter pairing code\" and type the 6 digits. You\'ll get a message that pairing succeeded.
Go back to Shizuku and tap \"Start\". After a few seconds it shows \"Shizuku is running\" at the top.
Open Toolbox+, tap \"Grant permission\" and then \"Allow all the time\". The lights can now be controlled.

string-array.name: guide_reboot_bodies
string-array.item: Make sure you are connected to Wi-Fi.
Open Toolbox+ and tap \"Start Shizuku\", or tap one of the Toolbox+ quick settings tiles.
Tap \"Start\" in Shizuku. If wireless debugging is off, turn it on in developer options first.
Go back to Toolbox+. It connects by itself.

string-array.name: guide_tips
string-array.item: Toolbox+ only needs Shizuku to connect. After that the lights keep working until the phone restarts, even if you stop Shizuku or turn off Wi-Fi.
Check Shizuku\'s settings for an option to start on boot. Then you don\'t need to do anything after a restart as long as there is Wi-Fi.
In developer options, turn on \"Disable adb authorization timeout\". Otherwise you have to pair again after 7 days without use.
No Wi-Fi at the campsite? After a restart the stock Toolbox app and the lamp\'s hardware button still work.
With a computer running ADB you can also start Shizuku with the command it shows under \"Start via connected computer\".
